turnaround_reason: Over-levered freight/logistics name after the debt-funded Omni acquisition. Strategic review was supposed to unlock a sale; instead it produced no buyer, and the plan is now piecemeal asset sales to delever.
bullish_points: Selling non-core assets (Intermodal, two Omni units) to pay down debt
Any credible deleveraging or surprise whole-company bid is a levered equity re-rate
bearish_points: Net debt ~5.5x EBITDA; negative book value (P/B -4.7) — equity is a thin stub
Strategic review produced NO actionable sale — PE interest waned, stock fell 22% in May
A ~$250M-revenue customer is shifting most volume away starting early 2027
Net margin -11.4%; covenant steps down to 5.5x by Q4 2026 leaving little cushion
catalyst: Asset-sale proceeds / deleveraging milestones or a renewed take-private bid
catalyst_timing: Ongoing through 2026; customer headwind hits early 2027
suggested_trade: Pass — or tiny speculative spot only for distressed-equity risk appetite
key_risk: Covenant breach / dilutive refinancing wiping out the equity stub before deleveraging works
would_skip_if: Skip unless a concrete deleveraging path or bid emerges; the 2027 customer loss caps the thesis
